example_sets.sentence_1: Although traveling by private car costs less per person, I use public transportation for environmental reasons.
example_sets.sentence_2: Although public transportation is better for the environment, I travel by private car because it costs less per person.

example_sets.sentence_1: Although the high upfront cost would strain my household budget, I install a residential solar power system for the sake of the environment.
example_sets.sentence_2: I would like to install a residential solar power system for the sake of the environment, but I do not because the high upfront cost would strain my household budget.

example_sets.sentence_1: I donate to an environmental organization, even if it means having less disposable income.
example_sets.sentence_2: I do not donate to an environmental organization because I do not want to reduce my disposable income.

example_sets.sentence_1: Although animal-based meat tastes better to me, I choose and eat plant-based meat for environmental reasons.
example_sets.sentence_2: Although plant-based meat is better for the environment, I choose animal-based meat because I find it tastier.

example_sets.sentence_1: Taking a bath or shower feels good, but I try to reduce how often and how long I do so to conserve water.
example_sets.sentence_2: I should reduce how often and how long I take baths or showers to conserve water, but I do so frequently and for a long time because it feels good.

example_sets.topic: Extending product use and repairing products
example_sets.sentence_1: Buying a brand-new, pristine item is exciting and makes me happy, but I try to use my belongings for as long as possible and avoid buying new ones because replacing usable items feels wasteful.
example_sets.sentence_2: I should use my belongings for as long as possible and avoid buying new ones because replacing usable items feels wasteful, but I buy brand-new, pristine items because doing so is exciting and makes me happy.

example_sets.sentence_1: Although using reusable chopsticks means having to wash them, I use them for meals at home instead of disposable chopsticks to reduce waste.
example_sets.sentence_2: Although disposable chopsticks create waste, I use them for meals at home because they are convenient and require no washing.

example_sets.topic: Checking environmental labels and certifications when shopping
example_sets.sentence_1: When buying a product, I prioritize whether it has environmental labels or certifications over its functionality or convenience for me.
example_sets.sentence_2: When buying a product, I prioritize its functionality or convenience for me over whether it has environmental labels or certifications.

example_sets.sentence_1: A gas stove is more convenient and efficient, but I cook with an induction cooktop because using electricity is better for the environment.
example_sets.sentence_2: Using electricity is better for the environment, but I cook with a gas stove because it is more convenient and efficient.

4_social_belonging.factor_ja_name: 社会的要因 (関係維持・所属)

example_sets.topic: Use of heating and air conditioning
example_sets.sentence_1: A friend wants to leave the air conditioning on while we are out so the home stays cool when we return, but I turn it off while we are away.
example_sets.sentence_2: A friend wants to leave the air conditioning on while we are out so the home stays cool when we return, so I leave it on while we are away.

example_sets.sentence_1: On a group trip, someone suggests that flying would be the easiest option, but I choose another mode of transportation for environmental reasons.
example_sets.sentence_2: On a group trip, someone suggests that flying would be the easiest option. Although another mode of transportation would be better for the environment, I choose to fly.

example_sets.sentence_1: For an annual group trip, I choose a new ecotourism itinerary instead of the usual plan that participants expect and that has been followed in previous years.
example_sets.sentence_2: For an annual group trip, ecotourism is considered as an option, but I choose the usual plan that participants expect and that has been followed in previous years.

5_social_reputation.factor_ja_name: 社会的要因 (周囲からの評価・評判)

example_sets.sentence_1: People may distance themselves from me for being outspoken, but I actively share information about environmental issues.
example_sets.sentence_2: I avoid sharing information about environmental issues because people may distance themselves from me for being outspoken.

example_sets.sentence_1: When buying a product, I choose a used item rather than a new one, regardless of what others may think of me.
example_sets.sentence_2: When buying a product, I choose a new item rather than a used one because I care about what others may think of me.

example_sets.topic: Use of heating and air conditioning
example_sets.sentence_1: Although I care about what others may think of me, I limit the use of heating and air conditioning as much as possible at home or in my car, even when I have guests.
example_sets.sentence_2: Because I care about what others may think of me, I use heating or air conditioning freely at home or in my car when I have guests.

6_social_order_and_norms.factor_ja_name: 社会的要因 (文化・規範・秩序)

example_sets.sentence_1: Because gift packaging is likely to be discarded, I avoid wrapping gifts more than necessary.
example_sets.sentence_2: Although gift packaging is likely to be discarded, I wrap gifts elaborately.

example_sets.sentence_1: When relatives gather, there is a tradition of preparing more food than can be eaten, but I try to prepare less to reduce food waste.
example_sets.sentence_2: When relatives gather, there is a tradition of preparing more food than can be eaten, so I uphold the tradition and do not reduce the amount of food, despite concerns about food waste.

example_sets.topic: Choosing how agricultural products are grown
example_sets.sentence_1: Even when a locally renowned crop is produced using traditional methods, I do not buy it if those methods harm the environment; instead, I buy crops produced more sustainably in another region.
example_sets.sentence_2: Even if the traditional methods used to produce a locally renowned crop harm the environment, I buy that traditional local crop rather than a crop produced more sustainably in another region.
